name: URTC-SMART-RACK
build: bash build_firmware.sh. Real host-native unit tests run before the arm-none-eabi-gcc cross-compile.
notes: Hardware-independent pure-C logic, host-tested on a PC only: tool-ID decoding, usage and maintenance tracking, the Smart Idle pre-heat target with a safe-state target, a versioned rack command protocol (framing with CRC8, actuation-limit validation, a link watchdog with a wraparound-aware sequence check and a session reset on recovery), a multi-slot inventory (a tool is never in two slots at once, per-slot pre-heat target by tool identity), per-tool limits, and the layer that applies a decision to the inventory and holds every slot in the safe state while the link is lost. A host-side scenario harness plays valid, corrupted, out-of-range, timed-out and duplicate frames through the whole pipeline, 531 host-native test assertions in all, and the ARM cross-compile is verified with a size report. Real CAN/F-RAM/GPIO I/O to drive tool tracking and pre-heating needs a real PCB, which does not exist yet.
